approved_by_user: 2026-11-24 ("yes please continue": Qwen Code harness, model default sampling, the shell-timeout note)
question: With Qwen Code (auto-compaction) as the harness, can Qwen3.8-27B work on m256 for the full session, and what does it score?
where: auh7-1b-gpu-240, task on HIP device 0, lock /tmp/phibench-auh7-240-gpus.lock
model_server: as in specs/qwen-agent-pilot-2026-11-24.json (vLLM 0.32.0, TP 4 on GPUs 4-7, context 131072, TRITON_ATTN, reasoning parser qwen3), plus tool calls: --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder
sampling: the model's generation_config.json defaults (temperature 1.0, top_k 20, top_p 0.95); Qwen Code sends no sampling parameters. Runs 1 and 2 used temperature 0.6.

harness.agent: Qwen Code 0.28.4 on Node.js 26.12.1, mounted read-only at /opt/agent, run headless: qwen --yolo --auth-type openai --output-format stream-json PROMPT
harness.settings: contextWindowSize 131072 (auto-compaction at Qwen Code's default, an estimated 98k tokens), request timeout 1 h, chat recording on, raw OpenAI logging to /logs/agent/openai, usage statistics, telemetry and auto-update off, tools web_search, web_fetch and image_gen removed
harness.environment: writable sandbox of the task image, apptainer exec --fakeroot --contain --cleanenv --no-home, /dev/kfd and /dev/dri bound, a host directory at /tmp, HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, working directory /app/repo, proxy variables unset (no route to the internet)
harness.prompt: instruction.md verbatim, then: '---' and 'Note on your shell tool: a command runs for at most 2 minutes unless you give it a longer timeout (up to 10 minutes). `bash /opt/loop/submit.sh` takes about 5 minutes.'
harness.limits: wall time 14400 s (timeout --signal=INT, killed 60 s later), 16 scored submissions (the task's own limit)

final_score: scripts/final_score.sh, unchanged from specs/qwen-agent-pilot-2026-11-24.json: stop the server, every GPU idle, auto-finalize if at least one submission and no finalize, /tests created, tests/test.sh in the solver's sandbox, every GPU idle after
audit: the stream and raw API logs searched for any read of /opt/loop/private, /tests or the patches, and for network commands; reported, the score unchanged
not_a_claim: one run on one task; harness and sampling both differ from runs 1 and 2, so the comparison with them cannot be attributed to either alone
stop_on: a GPU outside 4-7 busy before or after a timing run
